title: app.secret_changed
description: A secret of a web app got a value: entered by a person, generated or rotated. `node_id` of the entry is the app node. The name and the action only, never a value. A scheduled rotation has the app as actor. **Actor of platform actions** (decision 0006, review R14): when the platform acts on its own, the actor is the app (`{kind: app, id: <app node ID>}`), `on_behalf_of` is null, and the reason is in `data`. This schema is the `data` of a journal entry with `type` `app.secret_changed`. Step 3, planned (decision 0004-21, docs/STEP3.md).
